new_entities.name: Hydrolysed collagen peptides
new_entities.description: Orally consumed hydrolysed collagen peptide supplements marketed for skin, joint, and connective tissue support.

new_entities.name: Joint pain in osteoarthritis
new_entities.description: Pain severity or symptomatic burden in osteoarthritis.

edges.effect_quant: A 2023 meta-analysis of four knee-osteoarthritis trials found a significant pooled pain-relief signal for collagen peptides versus placebo, but individual randomized trials are inconsistent, including a 2025 placebo-controlled study that found no between-group advantage.
edges.population: adults with knee or hip osteoarthritis taking oral hydrolysed collagen formulations for several weeks to months
edges.mechanism: Collagen hydrolysates may influence cartilage matrix turnover and joint symptom perception, but the clinical literature suggests any benefit is modest and formulation-dependent rather than uniformly robust.
edges.summary: Collagen peptides for osteoarthritis pain sit in the mixed zone. Pooled analyses suggest small symptomatic benefit, but better recent randomized evidence has been less enthusiastic, so this is not a high-certainty joint-pain intervention.
edges.caveats: This edge should not be sold as a disease-modifying osteoarthritis treatment. Results vary by formulation, comparator, and trial quality, and many studies remain small or commercially flavored.

evidence.citation: XingR et al 2023 J Orthop Surg Res
evidence.notes: Analgesic efficacy of collagen peptide in knee osteoarthritis: a meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
